clues.it: Bruno era nella 2ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e a ovest di Carla.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 2nd column, in the 1st row and west of Carla.

clues.it: Carla era nella 6ª colonna, nella 2ª riga e a ovest di Marta.
clues.en: Carla was in the 6th column, in the 2nd row and west of Marta.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a una consolle e sul Ponte di Comando, ma non era accanto a un droide.
clues.en: Elena was beside a console and on the Command Deck, but was not beside a droid.

clues.it: Giada era nella 8ª colonna, accanto a un droide e a nord di Olga.
clues.en: Giada was in the 8th column, beside a droid and north of Olga.

clues.it: Dario era nel Criosonno, ma non era accanto a un fascio di cavi.
clues.en: Dario was in the Cryo Bay, but was not beside a cable bundle.

clues.it: Olga era nella 4ª colonna, nella 6ª riga e a ovest di Marta.
clues.en: Olga was in the 4th column, in the 6th row and west of Marta.

clues.it: Marta era nella 7ª riga, accanto a una perdita di refrigerante e nell'Hangar.
clues.en: Marta was in the 7th row, beside a coolant spill and in the Hangar.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Ugo era nell'Hangar, ma non era accanto a una criocapsula.
clues.en: Ugo was in the Hangar, but was not beside a cryopod.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 2ª.

steps.en: Carla can only be in the 2nd row: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 3rd, column 3rd.
